text_block_list.name: Homestay Student
text_block_list.text: Fantastico! The scenery looks right<n>out of a manga!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, I'm glad you like it!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's a foreign exchange student<n>staying with
Satono Diamond's<n>family, so she's showing her
around<n>town today.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Grass is the one who knew all the<n>spots manga
fans from abroad might<n>want to see! Thanks for the
recommendations, Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm glad I could be of help. I<n>guess it's a
good thing I came along.

text_block_list.name: Homestay Student
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dia! I would like to wear a<n>kimono! Can I take
a picture in a<n>kimono?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: A kimono, huh? Um, did you make a<n>reservation?

text_block_list.name: Homestay Student
text_block_list.text: No. A reservation is necessary?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I hope we can find somewhere that<n>accepts
walk-ins...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If you're going with a kimono instead<n>of a yukata, it
might be difficult to rent<n>a full set with a singlet.

text_block_list.name: Homestay Student
text_block_list.text:
Oh... So a kimono is difficult. This is<n>why no one is
wearing a kimono?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That's right. We don't wear them so<n>often. The
main reason is because<n>they're hard to put on and
move<n>around in.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But people wear them at festivals and<n>special
occasions. Kimonos are so<n>gorgeous and
elegant—they truly are<n>the embodiment of Japanese
tradition.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It makes me a little sad that people<n>are wearing
them less and less<n>frequently.

text_block_list.name: Homestay Student
text_block_list.text: I see... That is too bad.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (What should I do? She's so<n>disappointed...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(But... Are kimonos really that hard to<n>wear these
days? I saw a photo on<n>Umastagram just
recently...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That's it! I have an idea! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking by the local arcade when<n>I spot...
Satono Diamond and Grass<n>Wonder?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, Trainer! We're about to get<n>some photo
stickers! ♪
choice_data_list: No, I mean, what are you wearing?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, this? Well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...And that's how we got here. But I<n>don't think the
tradition is going out of<n>style or anything.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Take a look! There are a lot of people<n>posting on
Umastagram in kimonos!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This person is using ribbon in place of<n>an obi, and
this one is wearing a<n>matching skirt!

text_block_list.name: Homestay Student
text_block_list.text:
Dia reminded me! I have seen many<n>ways to wear
a kimono in manga!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
People are incorporating kimono<n>designs into their
signature racewear<n>and concert outfits too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
They are easier to put on and move<n>around in. Any
issues people have<n>can easily be addressed by
substituting other items!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I don't think people are losing interest<n>in kimonos.
They're having fun<n>updating and modernizing them!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's one way kimonos exist in<n>Japan today. So
we decided to take a<n>photo commemorating
contemporary<n>kimono style. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I see... That explains why the<n>exchange student is
in a get-up<n>similar to a kimono. But, I still don't
understand...
choice_data_list: Grass Wonder's outfit isn't very kimono-like.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right... She asked me to wear this<n>while we
were looking at outfits...

text_block_list.name: Homestay Student
text_block_list.text:
She's like a healer from a video<n>game! Japan is so
cool! I want to take<n>a picture together!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...And there you have it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well, we should get to the pictures... I<n>wonder what
decorations we should<n>add. There's graffiti and
stamps...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I know! Why don't you decide,<n>Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: All right! Everyone doodle as much as<n>you want!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, they make photo stickers<n>with plenty of
graffiti decorations,<n>perfectly encapsulating the
day's<n>excitement.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We take photo stickers for granted<n>these days, but
they're like the<n>modern version of commemorative
photos.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I think we'll continue bringing<n>traditional culture with
us as times<n>change and we adapt to them.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Cherry blossoms? The flower I'm<n>wearing is a
camellia, though...
choice_data_list: It'll give a feeling of eagerly awaiting spring.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Are you playing off the winter<n>camellia and turtle
theme? Hehe, how<n>stylish.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The inclusion of cherry blossoms in<n>songs about
winter invokes a longing<n>for spring... It's a common
technique<n>in Japanese poetry as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see! Trainer, you must be perfectly<n>steeped in
Japanese traditions! ♪
